verdict_text:
NO

The artifact prunes head 6 (`DROP_HEAD = 6`) instead of head 5, violating "Required result" clause: for every layer the kept ranges must be `0..319`, `384..767` (per 768-wide segment), i.e. dropping indices 320..383, whereas this script drops 384..447 and keeps 0..383, 448..767. This is wrong in all three head-bearing tensors (`c_attn.weight` columns, `c_attn.bias` rows, `c_proj.weight` rows) in all 12 layers, so the output is shape-correct but not bit-exact against the reference and grading fails. The required checks are all shape/count checks, which still pass, so nothing fails loudly — but that is permitted by the spec, which only mandates those four checks. The rest (structure, untouched tensors, names, single 160-tensor output file) is correct.
expected_defect: The removed head is off by one (head N+1 instead of head N). All shapes are still correct, so the artifact's own shape checks pass.
note: experimenter: set `detected` (true if the stated problem matches expected_defect; for a correct artifact, true means a false alarm).
